sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We're {MONEY} over plan, mostly because of the office move.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We can absorb it by delaying some hiring.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Which roles?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Two backfills in operations.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Delay those two backfills by one quarter.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Why are we over plan?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The office move, mainly, it's {MONEY} over.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Delaying two operations backfills would cover it.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Do that, push them out a quarter.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to switch to a new payroll provider.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The new provider is {PERCENT} cheaper and handles all our countries.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: When would we switch?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: At the start of the new tax year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Approved, switch at the start of the tax year.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The new payroll provider costs {PERCENT} less and covers every country we're in.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Timing?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Start of the tax year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Go ahead with it then.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The audit firm has raised its fees.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The new quote is {MONEY}, up by a third.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Run a tender with two other firms before we renew.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'll start it this month.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Our auditors want {MONEY} this year, a third more than last year.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's a big jump.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We tender with two other firms before renewing.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.
